title: Three-tier web app
description: The classic starting point: load balancer, stateless app servers, cache and database.

steps.title: One app server and a database
Load balancer and stateless app servers
steps.summary: Run several app servers so one can fail or be deployed without downtime.

steps.title: Cache hot reads
steps.summary: Keep frequent reads off the database.

notes.text: Sessions live in the cache, not on the server, so any instance can serve any request.

decisions.title: Cache-aside with a short TTL
decisions.why: Most pages read the same rows. A 60s TTL removes most database reads and keeps staleness bounded.
decisions.tradeoffs: Users may see data up to 60s old; invalidation logic in the app.
